concept_triple_providence_plut.label: Triple Providence / τριττὴ πρόνοια (Pseudo-Plutarch)
concept_triple_providence_plut.gloss: τριττὴ πρόνοια (trittē pronoia) - Providence at three levels: first god's thought, celestial gods' governance, daimones' guardianship.

concept_two_senses_fate_plut.label: Two Senses of Fate / εἱμαρμένη διχῶς (Pseudo-Plutarch)
concept_two_senses_fate_plut.gloss: εἱμαρμένη διχῶς (heimarmenē dichōs) - Fate in two senses: as activity (energeia) and as substance (ousia).

concept_two_sidedness_eph_hemin.label: Bilatéralité du τὸ ἐφ' ἡμῖν (two-sidedness)
concept_two_sidedness_eph_hemin.gloss: A two-sided feature attributed to Aristotle’s τὸ ἐφ’ ἡμῖν: in the circumstances at issue, what is up to an agent to do is also up to the agent not to do.

concept_two_source_metaphysics_platonist.label: Two-Source Metaphysics (Platonist)
concept_two_source_metaphysics_platonist.gloss: The distinctive Middle Platonist metaphysical position that the cosmos has TWO independent causal origins: divine providence (pronoia) and pre-existing matter (hyle).

concept_two_spirits_doctrine_s7t8u9v0.label: Two Spirits Doctrine (Qumran)
concept_two_spirits_doctrine_s7t8u9v0.gloss: Qumran sectarian doctrine of cosmic dualism: God created two spirits (Spirit of Truth and Spirit of Deceit) and assigned all humanity to one or the other.

concept_tyrannike_hamartia.label: Τυραννικὴ ἁμαρτία (Tyrannike Hamartia) - Tyrannical Sin
concept_tyrannike_hamartia.gloss: Melito's personification of sin as a tyrannical power.

concept_ultimate_responsibility_kane.label: Ultimate Responsibility (UR)
concept_ultimate_responsibility_kane.gloss: Robert Kane's development of Aristotelian ultimate origination, requiring that agents be ultimate sources of their actions through self-forming actions (SFAs)

concept_undescended_soul_plotinus.label: Undescended Soul Doctrine - Plotinus's Preservation of Soul's Divinity
concept_undescended_soul_plotinus.gloss: Plotinus's distinctive doctrine that a part of the human soul remains always in the intelligible realm (nous) and never fully descends into the body.

concept_voluntarism_medieval_m7n8o9p0.label: Voluntarism (Medieval)
concept_voluntarism_medieval_m7n8o9p0.gloss: Position of Scotus, Ockham, and Franciscan tradition against Thomistic intellectualism.

concept_voluntas_y7z8a9b0.label: Will (Voluntas)
concept_voluntas_y7z8a9b0.gloss: Étymologie : voluntas < radical vol- du verbe velle (« vouloir »), même racine que voluptas (« plaisir ») (le rapprochement avec le grec βούλομαι, d'une racine distincte, est contesté).

concept_yetzer_ha_ra_u3v4w5x6.label: Evil Inclination (Yetzer Ha-Ra)
concept_yetzer_ha_ra_u3v4w5x6.gloss: The 'evil inclination' or 'evil impulse' - human proclivity toward sin and selfishness.

concept_yetzer_ha_tov_y7z8a9b0.label: Good Inclination (Yetzer Ha-Tov)
concept_yetzer_ha_tov_y7z8a9b0.gloss: The 'good inclination' or 'good impulse' - human capacity for obedience, love of Torah, and righteousness.
